note: Bags deliberately NOT in the catalogue. Kept as a register so a future intake does not re-add them and re-run the same dead end. Removing a bag silently would leave nothing to explain why it never comes back.

amazon-21-expandable.reason: Amazon-owned brand. Our own intake brief forbids marketplace sources, so no permitted manufacturer specification exists and none ever will — this is a rule we chose, not a gap someone can close. See resources/bags/2026-08-31-amazon-21-expandable-gap.md

pacsafe-venturesafe-exp45.reason: The ECONYL variant is discontinued: its product URL now redirects to a current EXP45 built in recycled polyester under a different SKU. Applying the new bag's dimensions to the old record would be a different product wearing this one's name. See resources/bags/2026-08-31-pacsafe-venturesafe-exp45-gap.md
